title: How did consciousness evolve? - with Nicholas Humphrey
summary: A Royal Institution lecture in which Nicholas Humphrey presents his theory of phenomenal consciousness and its evolution. He draws on the book Sentience and discusses evidence for animal sentience.
why: Recommended as a good high-level view of Humphrey's book and his argument on how consciousness evolved.

quote.text: His recent RI lecture was great and a good high level view of the book.
